title: 第二十四章 拳头大就是道理
novel_title: 凡人修仙：谁说修仙必须灵力
content_zh:
空气中弥漫着微薄的灵力和淡淡的血腥味混合在一起，新的一天还在重复着昨天。

    侯紫和沈君壁在老崔的带领下向入口处走去。

    侯紫已经知道昨天的护卫队长叫毕景元，外号“贪狼”。在贫民窟散修眼里就是杀神，拿的孝敬可不少，还经常借故找事。

    昨晚老崔在杂物房里跟两人透了底，毕景元每年从他这儿抽的孝敬，够买一件中品法器。但这次查令牌，毕景元没提前打招呼，其中必有蹊跷。

    登记处的门开着。毕景元靠在窗口旁边的石墙上，长剑挂在腰间，手指慢慢敲着剑鞘。看到三人走过来，他的嘴角动了动，像是在笑，但眼睛里没有一丝笑意。

    “来了。”他说。

    老崔往前走了半步，把侯紫和沈君壁挡在身后。“毕队长，一大早就在这儿等着，看来最近贫民窟的治安挺清闲。”

    “老崔，这事跟你没关系。两个新来的，用的是死人令牌，按规矩得查清楚来路。”

    “不用查了。”老崔从怀里掏出两张契书，放在登记处的窗口上，“昨天刚签的学徒契。这两个人，现在是我崔家炼器铺的人。他们的来路，我担保。”

    毕景元的手指停在剑鞘上。他拿起契书翻了翻。“老崔收学徒，十年没收过新人。这次一次收两个。”他把契书放回窗口，“他们有什么手艺？”

    “会画符。”老崔指了指沈君壁，“他的符纸，品级不高，但手法是正的。我铺子里缺个符师。”

    毕景元看着沈君壁。沈君壁没有躲他的眼神，只是微微低了低头，算是行礼。毕景元没有追问，转头看向登记处老太太。“老崔的学徒，登记费怎么算？”

    老太太翻了一页册子，头也没抬。“学徒登记，半价。两块令牌，一共十颗下品灵石。”

    老崔从怀里掏出十颗灵石放在窗口。不是下品灵石，是十颗中品灵石，莹白如玉，在晨光里泛着柔和的荧光。登记处老太太的笔停在半空。毕景元的眼睛眯了一下。

    “老崔，学徒登记用中品灵石付账，你在坊市开了十几年铺子，从没这么大方过。”

    “最近生意好。”老崔说，语气淡得像在说今天天气不错。

    毕景元沉默了几息，然后摆了摆手。老太太收了灵石，从抽屉里拿出两块新木牌，换了登记信息，推到窗口。毕景元把剑从剑鞘里拔出来，搁在桌上。剑刃上泛着冷光，映出侯紫的脸。

    “令牌的事，就这么算了。”

    他收起剑，转身往门外走。走到门口，停了一步。“老崔，这次我给你面子。但下次你的人再犯事，就不是十颗中品灵石能解决的了。”
content_en:
The air was filled with a slight mixture of spiritual power and the faint smell of blood, and the new day was still repeating yesterday.

Hou Zi and Shen Junbi walked towards the entrance under the leadership of Lao Cui.

Hou Zi already knew that yesterday's guard captain was named Bi Jingyuan, nicknamed "Greedy Wolf".In the eyes of the casual cultivators in the slums, he is a god of murder. He is paid a lot of tribute and often makes excuses to make trouble.

Last night, Lao Cui told the two of them in the utility room that the money Bi Jingyuan drew from him every year was enough to buy a medium-grade magic weapon.But this time when checking the token, Bi Jingyuan didn't say hello in advance, so there must be something fishy.

The registration door is open.Bi Jingyuan leaned against the stone wall next to the window, his long sword hanging on his waist, and his fingers slowly tapping the scabbard.Seeing the three people approaching, the corners of his mouth moved as if he were smiling, but there was no trace of smile in his eyes.

"Coming," he said.

Lao Cui took half a step forward, blocking Hou Zi and Shen Junbi behind him."Captain Bi, I have been waiting here early in the morning. It seems that the security in the slums has been quite peaceful recently."

"Old Cui, this matter has nothing to do with you. The two newcomers used dead man's tokens. According to the rules, we must find out where they came from."

"No need to check." Lao Cui took out two deeds from his arms and placed them on the window of the registration office. "The apprenticeship deed just signed yesterday. These two people are now employees of my Cui family's weapon refining shop. I guarantee their origins."

Bi Jingyuan's fingers stopped on the scabbard.He picked up the deed and flipped through it."Old Cui accepts apprentices. He hasn't had any new ones in ten years. This time he accepts two at a time." He put the deed back to the window, "What skills do they have?"

"I can draw talismans." Lao Cui pointed at Shen Junbi, "His talisman paper is not of high grade, but the technique is correct. I am short of a talisman master in my shop."

Bi Jingyuan looked at Shen Junbi.Shen Junbi did not avoid his eyes, but lowered his head slightly as a salute.Bi Jingyuan did not ask further questions, but turned to look at the old lady at the registration desk."How is the registration fee calculated for Lao Cui's apprentice?"

The old lady flipped through a page of the book without raising her head."Apprentice registration, half price. Two tokens, a total of ten low-grade spiritual stones."

Lao Cui took out ten spiritual stones from his arms and placed them in the window.They were not low-grade spiritual stones, but ten middle-grade spiritual stones, as white as jade, glowing with soft fluorescence in the morning light.The pen of the old lady at the registration desk stopped in mid-air.Bi Jingyuan's eyes narrowed.

"Old Cui, the apprentice registration fee is paid with medium-grade spiritual stones. You have been running a shop in Fangshi for more than ten years, and you have never been so generous."

"Business has been good recently." Lao Cui said, his tone as calm as if he was saying that the weather is nice today.

Bi Jingyuan was silent for a few moments, then waved his hand.The old lady collected the spirit stones, took out two new wooden plaques from the drawer, changed the registration information, and pushed them to the window.Bi Jingyuan took out the sword from its scabbard and placed it on the table.The blade of the sword glowed with cold light, reflecting Hou Zi's face.

"Let's forget about the token."

He put away his sword, turned and walked out the door.He walked to the door and stopped for a step."Old Cui, I'll give you face this time. But next time your people do something wrong, it won't be solved by ten medium-grade spiritual stones."
